title: Pfeiffer 2018 · Experiment 3, auditory–vestibular congruency
citation: Pfeiffer, C., Noel, J. P., Serino, A., & Blanke, O. (2018). Vestibular modulation of peripersonal space boundaries. European Journal of Neuroscience, 47(7), 800-811.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.response: Detect touch quickly. Compare congruency effects and peri-head boundary across the sound-distance grid.

stimulus_type.source: Journal pp. 802–803, Stimuli and apparatus and Fig. 1

value.rendering: interaural level and time differences via spatial filters

source_provenance.source: Journal pp. 802–803, Stimuli and apparatus and Fig. 1
source_provenance.gap: Four candidate WAVs and a related MATLAB script are verified in the private backup. Their timing differs from the published sequence. Exact playback files, filter settings and hardware calibration remain unverified.

implementation_gaps: A vestibular drive scheduler must synchronize rotation with the directional headphone signal and tactile trigger and log the encoder position.
Exact physical output calibration, rotation-direction allocation within congruency and catch count are unavailable.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
